package service

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

// scenario for service_method_returns_map_string_any_output: Services that return dynamic maps instead of typed result contracts.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type AnalyticsService struct {
	repo AnalyticsRepository
}

func (s *AnalyticsService) GetData(ctx context.Context, metric string) map[string]any {
	results := s.repo.Query(ctx, metric)
	output := map[string]any{
		"metric":    metric,
		"timestamp": time.Now().UTC(),
		"values":    results,
	}
	if len(results) == 0 {
		output["status"] = "empty"
	} else {
		output["status"] = "ok"
		output["count"] = len(results)
	}
	return output
}

type AnalyticsRepository interface {
	Query(ctx context.Context, metric string) []float64
}
